scope: Read-only verification of 38 assigned gameplay candidates against direct and independently composed PR1878 code, plus the subsequently authorized guarded Crab pair implementation. Splash Wall is recorded only in the separate sub report.

method.direct: Read git archive of the exact PR1878 base head, isolated from the current worktree.

method.evidence: Every recorded needle is asserted present and includes the exact base file SHA-256, line and nearby excerpt. Historical labels are context only.
method.tests: No new blanket gameplay test claim is made by this source audit; executed Crab tests are recorded on that item.
